newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai sugar output reaches 1.8 million tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thai sugar output reaches 1.8 million tonnes.

text.p: Thailand's sugar cane crushing season has proceeded well, with 46 mills producing about 1.8 million tonnes of sugar so far, industry sources said on Monday.
As of January 22, around 19 million tonnes of cane had been crushed to produce 1.14 tonnes of raw sugar and 669,560 tonnes of white sugar.
The yield edged up to 94.96 kg of sugar per tonne of sugar cane from 92.54 kg last week. The commercial cane sugar (CCS) also picked up to 11.03 percent.
But overall performance still trailed the previous season, partly due to delays in crushing which affected the yield, they said.
Molasses production was recorded at 726,682 tonnes as of January 22, the sources said.
